ledger_policy.rule: Apply and verify one finding update at a time before the next update.

findings.affected_public_behavior: The release workflow can publish after its reduced gate without proof that the full CI surface passed for the exact release SHA.
Documentation targets intended for installed gems are not all proven present in the packaged artifact.
Console launchers advertise only executable embedded tools; the former static bridge fails closed and cannot return fabricated live data.
findings.reproduction_command: bundle exec rspec spec/console/tool_specs_spec.rb spec/console/bridge_spec.rb spec/console/cli_integration_spec.rb

findings.affected_public_behavior: Durable pipeline tasks expose completion and reconnect polling without claiming cancellation; tasks/cancel fails explicitly because Woods cannot safely stop and unpublish lock-owning work.
Preset/provider/store configuration validates required options, persists the resolved artifact contract, and reopens with the same provider and storage behavior.
findings.reproduction_command: bundle exec rspec spec/builder_spec.rb spec/resolved_config_spec.rb spec/mcp/config_resolver_spec.rb spec/integration/preset_persistence_spec.rb
